nodes.name: initToolRegistry.ts
nodes.summary: Core unified tool registry that loads builtin and CLI-agent tool metadata (icons, labels, actions, display behavior) from the Rust backend via Tauri and exposes lookup/accessor functions used across chat and simulator rendering.
nodes.languageNotes: Maintains internal Maps populated once via an async Tauri invoke, with `_set*`/`_reset*` exported setters intended for test injection.

nodes.name: initToolRegistry
nodes.summary: Bootstraps the tool registry by invoking the Rust backend once to fetch builtin and CLI tool metadata (icons, labels, actions, display behavior, aliases) and populating in-memory Maps used by all registry accessors.

nodes.name: getBuiltinSimulatorApp
nodes.summary: Looks up the simulator AppType for a builtin (non-CLI) tool name.

nodes.name: getBuiltinToolIconId
nodes.summary: Looks up the icon identifier for a builtin tool name.

nodes.name: getBuiltinToolActionIconId
nodes.summary: Looks up the icon identifier for a specific action of a builtin tool.

nodes.name: getBuiltinToolStatusIconId
nodes.summary: Looks up the icon identifier for a builtin tool at a given lifecycle status.

nodes.name: getToolActions
nodes.summary: Returns the list of available actions for a tool, resolving CLI aliases to their canonical name first.

nodes.name: getActionChatBlock
nodes.summary: Determines the chat-block rendering type for a specific tool action, falling back to the tool-level chat block.

nodes.name: getToolDisplayBehavior
nodes.summary: Determines how a tool action should be displayed (instant/stream/wait_for_result), falling back through action- and tool-level defaults.

nodes.name: getActionLabels
nodes.summary: Resolves the lifecycle label set (pending/success/error text) for a tool action, checking action-specific and tool-level maps.

nodes.name: getToolLabel
nodes.summary: Resolves the display label text for a tool at a given lifecycle state and action, the primary label-resolution entry point.

nodes.name: resolveCliAlias
nodes.summary: Looks up the alias entry for a raw CLI tool name.

nodes.name: getCliUiCanonical
nodes.summary: Resolves a raw CLI tool name (with optional wildcard suffix) to its UI-canonical name.

nodes.name: getCliStorageCanonical
nodes.summary: Resolves a raw CLI tool name to its storage-canonical name via the alias map.

nodes.name: getCliSimulatorApp
nodes.summary: Resolves a raw CLI tool name to its simulator AppType via the alias map.

nodes.name: getAllCliAliasKeys
nodes.summary: Returns all known raw CLI tool alias keys.

nodes.name: getAppTypeForTool
nodes.summary: Resolves the AppType (simulator routing target) for a tool function name, checking the builtin map first then the CLI alias map.

nodes.name: getAppSubtool
nodes.summary: Resolves the app-specific subtool classification for a tool function name, checking builtin and CLI maps.

nodes.name: getChatBlock
nodes.summary: Resolves the chat-block rendering type for a tool function name, checking builtin and CLI maps.

nodes.name: _resetToolRegistry
nodes.summary: Test-only helper that clears all in-memory registry Maps back to an uninitialized state.

nodes.name: _setBuiltinSimulatorMap
nodes.summary: Test-only setter injecting the builtin simulator-app Map.

nodes.name: _setBuiltinIconIdMap
nodes.summary: Test-only setter injecting the builtin icon-id Map.

nodes.name: _setBuiltinAppSubtoolMap
nodes.summary: Test-only setter injecting the builtin app-subtool Map.

nodes.name: _setBuiltinChatBlockMap
nodes.summary: Test-only setter injecting the builtin chat-block Map.

nodes.name: _setBuiltinLabelsMap
nodes.summary: Test-only setter injecting the builtin labels Map.

nodes.name: _setBuiltinActionsMap
nodes.summary: Test-only setter injecting the builtin actions Map.

nodes.name: _setBuiltinDisplayBehaviorMap
nodes.summary: Test-only setter injecting the builtin display-behavior Map.

nodes.name: _setBuiltinActionIconsMap
nodes.summary: Test-only setter injecting the builtin action-icons Map.

nodes.name: _setCliToolAliasMap
nodes.summary: Test-only setter injecting the CLI tool alias Map.

nodes.name: toolAliases.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves a raw CLI/tool name to its UI-canonical simulator app type via the tool registry.

nodes.name: resolveToolName
nodes.summary: Resolves a raw tool name to its UI-canonical simulator app type, trying the builtin registry then CLI alias resolution.

nodes.name: toolCategories.ts
nodes.summary: Classifies tools into semantic categories (browser, search, file, shell, message) and determines styled-output/activity-summary categorization for the UI.

nodes.name: getCategoryForUiCanonical
nodes.summary: Classifies a UI-canonical tool name into a broad category (file, search, conversation, other) using static name sets.

nodes.name: isBrowserTool
nodes.summary: Determines whether a tool function name represents a browser-app tool.

nodes.name: isSearchTool
nodes.summary: Determines whether a tool function name represents a search tool.

nodes.name: isFileTool
nodes.summary: Determines whether a tool function name represents a file-operation tool.

nodes.name: isShellTool
nodes.summary: Determines whether a tool function name represents a shell tool.

nodes.name: isMessageTool
nodes.summary: Determines whether a tool function name represents a conversation/message tool.

nodes.name: hasStyledOutput
nodes.summary: Determines whether a tool should render with rich/styled card output, based on category membership and browser/search tool checks.

nodes.name: getActivitySummaryCategory
nodes.summary: Derives an activity-summary category label from an action type and/or tool function name for summarized activity views.

nodes.name: toolRegistryDomain.ts
nodes.summary: Domain-specific tool classification helpers mapping tool function names to IDE event types and identifying delete-type tools.

nodes.name: getIDEEventType
nodes.summary: Maps a tool function name to its corresponding IDE event type via app-subtool classification.

nodes.name: isDeleteTool
nodes.summary: Determines whether a tool function name represents a delete-type operation, checking canonical name sets and storage-canonical resolution.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Type definitions and const enums for the tool registry: component loaders, context configs, app subtools, tool display behavior, and chat block types.

nodes.name: useToolLabel.ts
nodes.summary: React hooks that resolve and translate tool lifecycle labels (pending/success/error) for display, wrapping the tool registry's label lookups with i18n translation.

nodes.name: statusToLifecycle
nodes.summary: Maps a raw event status string to a simplified lifecycle phase (pending/success/error).

nodes.name: resolveLifecycleLabelKeys
nodes.summary: Resolves the i18n translation keys for a tool's pending/success/error labels, falling back to generic action labels.

nodes.name: useLifecycleLabels
nodes.summary: React hook returning translated pending/success/error label text for a tool action.

nodes.name: useToolLabelText
nodes.summary: React hook returning the translated display label text for a tool at a given lifecycle state.

nodes.name: universalProps.ts
nodes.summary: Central TypeScript type/interface definitions for universal tool-call rendering props, extracted-data shapes (edit, file, shell, search, todo, thinking), and per-event-type prop interfaces shared across the rendering layer.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure type-only module (no runtime exports) defining the contract implemented by all prop extractors in this batch.
